items.source: Sina Hong Kong-stock Hourly Digest (via k.sina.com.cn)
items.title: 新浪港股热点小时报丨2026年10月06日03时
items.summary: Sina's Oct 6, 03:00 hourly markets/fashion digest frames Gucci as mid-transformation with '12 consecutive quarters of declining sales' under Kering, offering discounts of 27-40% on select items, and positions it as a 'recovery-phase bet' rather than a value-preserving asset -- contrasted with Hermes/Chanel, which keep raising prices ~10% a year to protect scarcity premium.

items.title: Gucci在中国降价30%卖不动 奢侈品涨价时代终结
items.summary: Tencent News reports Gucci has posted 11 consecutive quarters of declining results, with 2025 revenue down roughly 22% to about 6 billion euros; cites HSBC data showing global luxury average prices rose only 2-3% in 2025 (smallest gain since 2019) and notes Kering is closing roughly 100 stores globally in 2026, about 40% of them in Asia, as the 'high-frequency steep price hike' era is declared over.

items.title: 賛否両論のデムナの「グッチ」は10点満点中の何点？ 業界アナリストが辛口リポート
items.summary: WWD Japan runs an industry analyst's scorecard giving Demna's Gucci debut show a 7.6 out of 10, calling it 'not a home run' that left both press and buyers somewhat disappointed, though an improvement on the prior De Sarno era; jackets and trousers passed muster but shoes and handbags were judged 'boring,' and several reviewers singled out the leggings as tasteless.

items.title: 누구나 원하는 모습으로 살아가는 법, 구찌 2027 봄/여름 컬렉션
items.summary: Vogue Korea's independent critic review of Demna's 2027 S/S 'The Store Show' is largely favorable, praising the 'twisted preps' section echoing his Balenciaga sensibility and calling the one-shoulder finale gown 'technically masterful,' concluding the show shows real creative growth -- an independent critical judgment (not brand copy), though the outlet's own prior/competing coverage (shoes, bags) in the same season drew more mixed marks elsewhere.

items.source: Weibo (古驰 Drip 运动鞋 质量/价格 讨论)
items.title: 中国制造的Gucci运动鞋定价七千元，性价比如何？
items.summary: Weibo discussion thread debates the roughly 7,000 RMB price of Gucci's China-made 'Drip' sneaker, with commenters split between those arguing the China-manufacture should mean a lower price than Italy-made styles and others defending the price as still cheaper than Gucci's usual Italian-made sneakers; several replies raise doubt about whether the luxury premium is justified once origin prestige is removed.

items.source: Weibo (代购渠道假货风险 analysis thread)
items.title: 古驰国内国外价差还有多少？2026年降价后，海淘可能比专柜更贵
items.summary: Community-style FAQ thread warns that daigou (overseas proxy-purchase) channels for Gucci carry high counterfeit risk, citing past cases where third-party authentication found Taobao 'official flagship' bags did not match genuine construction, and that counterfeits are especially common for hot-selling styles; concludes that after the 2026 China price cuts, buying at official boutiques or the flagship e-commerce store is now safer and often cheaper than daigou.

items.title: 구찌, 2026 봄·여름 아이웨어 캠페인 공개
items.summary: Esquire Korea runs a purely descriptive write-up of Gucci's eyewear campaign imagery (double-G acetate frames, horsebit-detailed round sunglasses) with no independent evaluative verdict -- straightforward activation/press-kit coverage with no critical or enthusiastic framing beyond product description.

items.title: 古驰地位崩塌？2025年营收暴跌22.5%，排名跌至第9，还是不是奢侈品第一梯队？
items.summary: Weibo analysis thread argues Gucci's status in the luxury hierarchy has collapsed, citing a reported 22.5% 2025 revenue drop and a fall to roughly 9th place among luxury houses by sales; comments are divided, with some agreeing Gucci has lost its top-tier standing and others countering that the brand retains strong archive/heritage value even amid the current slump.
